Public copy uses the Hillcrest NAP, named Jared, and job-specific review proof. Home, replacement, and repair keep Springfield address and phone. Replacement names first-reroof, tear-off/new shingles, and cleanup from bound reviews. Repair stays on the Hoffman leak/seal/flue visit. Contested hours are omitted.

Prescribed leads are used: C Jackson, Neal Richardson Sr, Jonathan Hoffman. Home quotes C Jackson, Hunter Gaston, and Josh Baird. Replacement quotes Neal, Laura, and Linda and keeps Grable, David, and Roger as unquoted authorized inventory. Repair quotes Hoffman only.

Each public page has a distinct decision job and a next step. Replacement moves keep-vs-reroof, estimate/owner review, shingle method, named jobs, cleanup, then call. Repair moves keep-the-roof, same-visit scope, honest thin evidence, boundaries, then call. Home routes. Contact is reachability.

Public copy reads as local Springfield roofing, not an audit memo. Owner-facing pages do not shame the live site, do not recite retrieval counts, and do not use contrast or design instructions. Internal strategy stays internal.

Replacement, repair, home, and contact do different jobs. Replacement is the roof coming off. Repair is the roof that stays. Home is the company hub with generic completed-roof proof. Contact has no reviews.
Home routes into the two service pages instead of restating them. Home does not use Neal, Hoffman, or replacement-method proof. It sends reroof and keep-the-roof jobs to their URLs.
Contact is phone, address, and route-outs only. No review placements, no hours claim, no second address, no service SLA.

Strategy Overview is internal, four-page, and does not self-approve Architect QA. No public URL/path/route fields. Better-future language. Architect slots remain awaiting Josh's look and are not accepted. No merge/build/deploy statement is present.

Named-job timing and price stay in the reviews, not as company offers. Replacement and repair tell the named jobs in past tense. Public copy does not convert evening, early-morning-to-dark, within-a-week, promptly, or SWIFT language into company offers. No 24/7, no hail/commercial/storm product, no star rating or review count.

Service pages stay tied to named jobs; repair is long because the visit is unpacked, not because extra jobs were invented. Repair remains Grade C with one suitable review. Replacement uses six named reroofs without minting extra URLs. No padding toward a third service.
